message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t use your API key. However, I can guide you through how to make the request yourself.

Here’s a quick example using `curl`:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/youtube.com/comments?limit=10&cursor=abc" \
     -H "x-apikey: my_api"
```

Or, if you prefer Python with the `requests` library:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/youtube.com/comments"
headers = {"x-apikey": "my_api"}
params = {"limit": 10, "cursor": "abc"}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure you replace `"my_api"` with your actual API key and keep it secure. If you run into any errors or need further help, let me know!
